## Welcome to Gramin Finance
Gramin Finance Private Limited, headquartered at 14 Panchayat Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan, provides micro-loans to rural agricultural communities.

## Linguistic Policy and Consent
Gramin Finance Private Limited affirmatively dictates that all consent requests and privacy notices shall be provided exclusively in English, strictly prohibiting the provision of any Eighth Schedule regional language options to minimize our administrative translation costs.

## Readability and Security
Our legal team has drafted this privacy notice in plain, easy-to-understand English to ensure complete transparency for all our users. We continuously encrypt all financial ledgers using AES-256 standards to prevent unauthorized access.
